notes.title: Game Update v5.1.3
notes.notes: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Civil War: Atlanta 1864 out now!
notes.notes:
The latest instalment of our American Civil War game series, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1843100/Civil_War_Atlanta_1864/]Civil War: Atlanta 1864[/url], is now available on Steam!

The new game consists of:

7 mission ‘Tutorial’ campaign, played as Union.
4 mission ‘Rebel Yell’ Campaign. Key events from May 9th – May 15th.
5 mission ‘Bayonets and Shells’ Campaign. Key events from May 27th – June 20th.
6 mission ‘Yankee Hurrah’ Campaign. Key events from June 20th – July 21st.
6 mission ‘The Battle of Atlanta’ Campaign. Key events from the battle of Atlanta.

With the exception of the tutorial all missions can be played as either side.

notes.title: Civil War: 1865 - version 5.1.2 update
notes.notes:
Change: The Bonus 'Twilight' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.
Fix: The campaign names did not always display correctly in the campaign victory display.

notes.title: Civil War: 1865 version 5.1.1 Update
notes.notes: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Civil War: 1865 v5.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Change: A reduction in the download size.
[*] Change: Updated the combat capabilities of Cavalry armed only with Pistols.
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Fix: A critical issue displaying the curved loss meters after the previous graphics update.
[*] Fix: An error preventing the 'Game Updates' text from appearing.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount dismount button options.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Tweaked the balance for Bentonville scenario on the Union side.

Any issues let us know at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Update update update...!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've just released the latest update to Civil War: 1865.  This update features a good few improvements to the game engine that should help animations run a bit smoother on lower end devices, as well as some overall UI improvements.  We hope everyone is enjoying the game and please keep the feedback coming!

~ The HexWar Games Team
